title: Show the uptime and the system load
description: Show how long the system has been running and the load average

examples.description: Show the uptime and load average
Pretty format (up X days Y hours)
Date and time of the last boot

notes: Does not require sudo. Load average: 1 min, 5 min, 15 min. Compare it with the number of CPUs.
